title: Embedding Videos
instructions: The video question type embeds an HTML5 video from any URL. The src can be either an absolute URL or a path to a file in this project's static/ folder — this example uses /static/example_video.webm. When force_watch is true, the Continue button stays disabled (with a notice next to it) until the participant has watched completion_threshold of the video.

questions.title: 1. Display-only video
questions.text: No force_watch, no id, native controls. The participant can play, pause, scrub, or skip past the video entirely.

questions.title: 2. Force-watch with native controls
questions.text: force_watch is on, native controls are visible, and a snap-back guard prevents seeking past the supposed playhead. An id is set, so the participant's start time, end time, and accumulated watched seconds will be saved to the database. Try seeking forward — the seek bar snaps back, and the Continue button stays disabled until you've watched the video through.

questions.title: 3. Force-watch with minimal controls
questions.text: minimal_controls is on, so the native scrubber is hidden entirely — only a custom Play/Pause button is shown. Seeking is impossible by construction. Watched-time still persists across page refreshes via the saved {id}_watched column.
